notes.title: Secret Summer bug fix for 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! I have uploaded a new build for Windows, Mac and Linux to hopefully clear up the problem some of you were having with the latest update that added a scene gallery and walk through mod. So just go play the game like normal and you will see the UPDATE button.

Please let me know if there's any more trouble!

notes.title: SECRET SUMMER FULL RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! Just wanted to let you know that I am in the process of finishing up the game as I edit and do beta testing for bugs and mistakes, etc. 

The final version of the game will contain the CORAL, ZOE and IRENE endings. So I'm planning to release the full version early next month! (JULY)

notes.title: FIX for saves not working with new update!
notes.notes:
Hey, guys. A few of you have reported your saves not working with the jump from .10 to .15, and you get this error

***AttributeError: 'TransformState' object has no attribute 'size'***

I have tried getting this error and everything works fine for me. And seems to be working fine for most players, but if you are getting this error then it seems like there are simple fixes.

1) Click 'rollback' a few times and see if that fixes it. Click it as much as 10 times if you have to.

2) Click 'ignore' and see if that helps.

3) Restart a new game. And skip to where you were previously. This should take 5 to 10 minutes.

4) Reinstall and restart a new game.

Again, this seems to be an issue with just a few players and I think maybe it's Windows, so please try these methods out and it should work.

notes.title: SECRET SUMMER .15 UPDATE!
notes.notes: Hey, guys! I have been working on the game and here are five more updates. There will be regular scheduled updates from here as we move to the end of the game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Secret Summer (version 0.10) Small Bug Fix!
notes.notes: Hey, guys! This small update fixes an error that shows on screen in update 10 when you are with Irene talking to certain foreigners. (Don't want to spoil!) This patch also fixes a mistake in the code where you would skip some content if you weren't on the Leanne path.
